```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Senate bill should be militantly opposed because it will gut Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Medicaid is a single-payer system that covers 74 million low-income, disabled and elderly Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The bill would cut $880 billion over 10 years from Medicaid, over one-quarter of the previous allocation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"13 million working adults and children added by the 31 states that accepted the Affordable Care Act’s federal funding of Medicaid coverage for working families earning $22 to $34,000 dollars will lose their coverage by 2023.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Major rollbacks in the extent of Medicaid coverage will occur from 2020 on.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An estimated additional 14 million more Medicaid recipients will likely lose Medicaid coverage as states trim their rolls to deal with lost federal revenue.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"States unwilling to radically increase their own contributions to Medicaid will be denying nursing home coverage and disability rehabilitation services to millions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The bill cuts $300 billion over ten years for premium subsidies for people who do not get insurance through employers and who must buy their own policies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The bill eliminates federal subsidies for low-income families’ out-of-pocket expenses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Eliminating federal subsidies for low-income families’ out-of-pocket expenses would radically increase the already excessive premiums, co-pays and deductibles faced by many Affordable Care Act beneficiaries.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Eliminating the individual mandate will cause insurance pools to be increasingly dominated by the elderly and sick.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
